notes.zh: 审阅注：首次进入有虚境隧道的星系时触发（on_entering_system_first_time，00_on_actions.txt:930），“虚境导师”起源与已自建隧道的帝国除外。隧道总枢纽随虚境行者城邦星系生成（overlord_initializers.txt:595），各地节点由虚境信标产生（enclave_effects.txt:510）。
notes.en: Review note: fires on first entering a system with a Shroud Tunnel (on_entering_system_first_time, 00_on_actions.txt:930), except for the Teachers of the Shroud origin and empires that built their own tunnel. The tunnel nexus is spawned with the Shroudwalker enclave system (overlord_initializers.txt:595); local nodes come from Shroud Beacons (enclave_effects.txt:510).

notes.zh: 审阅注：建成从虚境行者处购得许可的“虚境信标”恒星基地建筑时触发（00_starbase_buildings.txt:1185）。
notes.en: Review note: fires when the Shroud Beacon starbase building, licensed from the Shroudwalkers, is completed (00_starbase_buildings.txt:1185).
